title: polystichum aculeatum subsp. lobatum
intro: Polystichum aculeatum subsp. lobatum, commonly known as the Alpine Lady Fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to provide relief from various health conditions, including inflammation, pain, and anxiety, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of Polystichum aculeatum subsp. lobatum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, that have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities. However, more research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and safety of using this plant for medicinal purposes.
